chunks: Musa ibn al-Qasim from Ibrahim ibn Abi Sammal from Mu'awiya ibn 'Ammar from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
Then you come to the Station of Ibrahim (peace be upon him) and pray two rak'ahs in it, and make it in front of you.
And in the second rak'ah, 'Say, O disbelievers.'
Then you recite the Tashahhud, praise Allah, and extol Him.

key_terms.أَمَامًا: In front of you (as a qibla reference)
key_terms.تَشَهَّدْ: Recite the Tashahhud (testimony of faith and blessings)
key_terms.مَقَامَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ: The Station of Ibrahim, a stone in the Kaaba used by Prophet Ibrahim during its construction

ai.seo_question: What are the recommended surahs to recite in the two rak'ahs of Tawaf prayer according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This narration from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* specifies the ritual prayer of Tawaf, emphasizing the physical orientation towards the Maqam Ibrahim as a focal point of devotion. It prescribes the recitation of Surah Al-Ikhlas and Al-Kafirun, linking the theological concepts of divine unity and distinctness from polytheism to the act of circumambulation. This practice underscores the integration of creedal affirmation with physical worship in Shia jurisprudence.
